goal: Respond to review that Stegosaurus improves most if the dorsal plates are recognizable by making the first MVP image prioritize a clear separated plate row over natural-scene polish.

required: many separate flat bony dorsal plates
largest plates over the mid-back and hips
smaller plates toward the neck and tail base
rejectIf: plate row hides the body profile
tail spikes read as extra tails or a second head

experiments.finding: Readable and balanced, but the lower broader variant has a stronger first-glance Stegosaurus plate silhouette.
Selected. The flat kite-shaped plates are countable, separated, and scaled from small neck/tail-base plates to larger mid-back plates while preserving a low body and four-spike thagomizer.
Readable but taller; it risks drifting toward a high triangular plate silhouette.

decision.status: accepted as MVP structure reference, not final paleoart
decision.reason: The user review correctly identified dorsal plates as the blocking issue. Natural-scene candidates still collapse into too few rounded fins, so the app now leads with a clearer project-owned plate gate until a Stegosaurus-specific LoRA or stronger reference-conditioned route can naturalize the structure.
